baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired negatives around تُدْرِكَ and سَابِقُ resolve into وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Catching and getting ahead are excluded while motion continues: each member follows a circular celestial course with fluid, sustained movement, so coordination rather than immobility prevents collision or inversion.

activation_trace.role: Suitability and yielding to what fits make the first negative a limit on admissible action, not a denial of motion.
Catching and reaching supply the possible interception that the sun is denied.
Advancing in a race supplies the possible temporal inversion denied to night.
The celestial circuit and course provide distinct but coordinated lanes for sun, moon, night, and day.
Swimming, running, and gliding through air supply continuous motion within those lanes.

changed_reading.before: A flat assertion that the celestial lights and times move.
changed_reading.after: A traffic-order model: every moving member remains active, but interception and reversal are excluded by its circular course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا ... يَنۢبَغِى and وَلَا ... سَابِقُ deny two kinds of crossing between named domains.
baseline_models.mechanism: The aggressive overstepping branch of ب غ ي makes the sun's non-catching a boundary ethic, while the failure-to-escape branch of س ب ق recasts pursuit as structurally unavailable; cosmic order consists in powers not trespassing into another member's allotment.

activation_trace.role: Crossing a limit through aggression supplies the transgression that is ruled out for the sun.
Actual arrival at the other body identifies what a domain-crossing event would accomplish.
Eluding a pursuer or becoming unreachable supplies the competitive asymmetry denied between night and day.
Circular recurrence supplies a way for domains to remain adjacent without one annexing the other.

changed_reading.before: The sun happens not to catch the moon, and night happens not to arrive first.
changed_reading.after: Each power is barred from transgressing the other's domain; non-overtaking is constitutive order rather than accidental spacing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِى فَلَكٍ immediately contains the plural swimmers يَسْبَحُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ship branch of ف ل ك and the swimming branch of س ب ح produce a navigational image in which every moving entity is borne within a rounded vessel or water-like medium, not merely placed on an abstract geometric line.

activation_trace.role: Total inclusion gathers every relevant mover into the same navigational statement.
A ship circling in water supplies the containing vehicle rather than a bare track.
Swimming in water or air supplies buoyant propulsion through the containing medium.

changed_reading.before: Each body travels along an orbit.
changed_reading.after: Each body can also be heard as a swimmer borne in a rounded vessel or navigable medium.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form يَسْبَحُونَ is anchored in the polyvalent root س ب ح.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root holds both rapid swimming and worshipful glorification. The physical circulation can therefore carry a secondary performative resonance: ordered movement itself enacts praise or transcendence without changing the verb into a different form.

activation_trace.role: Running and swimming provide the grammatical motion asserted in the focus.
Worship through praise and prayer supplies a secondary devotional resonance to the same root.
Declaring transcendence turns orderly locomotion into an implicit enactment of freedom from defect.

changed_reading.before: The plural subjects only swim or run.
changed_reading.after: Their swimming remains physical but can simultaneously resonate as ceaseless embodied glorification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun runs toward a stable station under a measure; the moon is measured through stations and returns. These adjacent details turn the focus's non-overtaking into the consequence of calibrated itineraries with limits, stages, and recurrence.

activation_trace.role: The celestial course is the focus anchor that receives the adjacent itinerary details.
Racing ahead names the ordering failure that a calibrated itinerary prevents.
Flowing or running supplies active solar transit rather than static placement.
Fixity and settlement supply the sun's stable destination or bound.
A quantity reaching its limit supplies the scale that constrains solar running.
Deliberate estimation and ordering supply the moon's staged itinerary.
A station or lodging supplies discrete lunar positions within the course.
Return after departure closes the lunar sequence into recurrence.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 proceeds sun, moon, then the rule preventing interception and inversion.
The singular solar destination and plural lunar stations converge in the focus's universal circular motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies running, a stable station, measure, lunar stations, and return; I infer that these features schedule the non-overtaking. A live alternative is that the solar endpoint and lunar recurrence are separate motions rather than one coordinated timetable.

changed_reading.after: They follow measured itineraries whose limits, stations, and return preserve sequence even while all remain in motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Created pairing followed by day being peeled from night recasts night/day as interlocked layers that alternately expose and cover, not contestants trying to pass one another.

activation_trace.role: Night and its darkness supply one member of the alternating pair.
Day's opening by light supplies the exposed member of the pair.
Competitive precedence is the surface model revised into controlled alternation.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies complementary pairing before night and day are introduced.
Removing skin or covering supplies a layered transition in which day is withdrawn from night.

structural_cues: The all-pairs statement at 36:36 immediately precedes the night/day sign at 36:37.
The focus repeats the same night/day nouns three ayat after the peeling image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complementary pairs and a skin-removal image; I infer an alternating layer mechanism that prevents precedence. A live alternative is that peeling describes only the onset of darkness and does not define the focus's orbital mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Night trails day in a temporal race.
changed_reading.after: Night and day exchange exposure like paired layers, so neither can invade or reverse the other's turn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the celestial swimmers, ف ل ك denotes a laden ship whose occupants are carried, followed by riding and the risk of drowning. This confirms a local navigational echo in the focus: orbit is not only a track but can be imagined as buoyant carriage through a medium.

activation_trace.role: The ship branch makes the focus's orbit available as a containing vehicle.
Swimming supplies movement through the same water-like field later made explicit by the ship sequence.
The repeated root now visibly names the ship, activating that branch retrospectively in 36:40.
Bearing a visible load supplies carriage within the vessel.
Filling or charging the ship emphasizes a containing medium with occupants rather than an empty geometric line.
Riding on a conveyance extends the carriage mechanism beyond the named ship.
Drowning supplies the peril of leaving supported navigation in the surrounding medium.

structural_cues: The ship use of ف ل ك occurs in the very next ayah after فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ.
Carrying, riding, and drowning sustain one navigational sequence across 36:41-43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate same-root ship, carriage, riding, and drowning; I infer a backward echo from vessel to celestial orbit. The live alternative is that 36:40 uses only the celestial-course sense and 36:41 begins an independent sign.

changed_reading.before: The ship sense was a remote lexical possibility inside the focus.
changed_reading.after: The next ayah activates it locally, making every celestial swimmer sound vessel-borne while leaving literal celestial courses primary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exact construction يَنۢبَغِى لَهُ rejects poetry as unfitting to the messenger, calibrating the focus's يَنۢبَغِى لَهَا toward role, category, and propriety. The sun's non-catching is therefore an inadmissible assignment, not merely insufficient power.

activation_trace.role: Suitability, availability, and yielding to what fits anchor the focus's modal prohibition.
Catching the moon is the action excluded from the sun's fitting role.
The same ينبغي له construction excludes an unfitting discourse category and thus calibrates the earlier modal force.
Poetry and poet supply the category judged not to fit, clarifying suitability rather than raw capacity.

structural_cues: 36:40 and 36:69 repeat ينبغي with the same له/لها complement pattern.
The second occurrence contrasts poetry with reminder and clear recitation, making category fit explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact repeated construction and an excluded discourse category; I infer backward lexical calibration from role-fit to the sun's action. A live alternative is that both suitability and physical impossibility remain active together.

changed_reading.before: The sun lacks the physical ability to catch the moon.
changed_reading.after: Catching the moon does not belong to the sun's allotted role or admissible mode of action, whether or not power is in view.

context_deltas.mechanism: سُبْحَانَ before the cosmic signs and again at the surah's close brackets يَسْبَحُونَ. The repeated root activates glorification as a live overtone of celestial swimming, while the closing dominion over every thing gives that motion a governed devotional horizon.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and running remain the focus's direct locomotor contribution.
The explicit declaration of transcendence opens the sign sequence and activates devotional resonance in the later cognate.
The closing declaration of transcendence completes a root refrain around the celestial swimmers.
Sovereignty supplies the governing horizon within which the ordered motion performs its praise.
Total inclusion expands the closing refrain from the celestial movers to every thing.

structural_cues: The س ب ح root occurs at 36:36, 36:40, and 36:83.
The first occurrence opens the paired cosmic signs and the last closes the whole surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a root refrain with distinct forms; I infer that the explicit glorifications color the intervening swimming as embodied praise. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no rhetorical transfer between سبحان and يسبحون.

changed_reading.before: Praise was only a dictionary-level possibility beside physical swimming.
changed_reading.after: The surah's repeated سبحان makes praise an audible secondary function of the celestial motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reuse فَٱسْتَبَقُوا ٱلصِّرَاطَ places racing on a path and makes sight a condition of reaching it. Fed back into the focus, سَابِقُ becomes lane-bound precedence: night cannot seize, cross, or outrun day on the ordered route.

activation_trace.role: Advancing in a race anchors the focus's possible precedence.
The celestial course supplies the lane on which precedence would have to occur.
The repeated root now explicitly describes racing toward a route, sharpening the spatial force of precedence.
Loss of light and sight supplies the blocked access that makes path-racing fail.
A straight road supplies the explicit route on which the later race is attempted.
Visual perception supplies route recognition, contrasting failed human access with lucid celestial order.

structural_cues: 36:66 is the only context reuse of the focus root س ب ق.
That reuse directly governs الصراط and is enclosed by erased eyes and inability to see.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root reuse tied to path and vision; I infer backward spatial calibration of night/day precedence as lane-bound racing. A live alternative is that the human path scene is independent and does not alter the temporal sense in 36:40.

changed_reading.before: Night simply cannot occur earlier than day.
changed_reading.after: Night cannot take or outrun day on the route assigned to their succession; precedence is spatially as well as temporally constrained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated كُلّ links all being gathered and made present, every celestial swimmer, and every thing returning. The local astronomical coordination becomes an exemplar of a wider gathering-and-return order rather than an isolated mechanics lesson.

activation_trace.role: Complete inclusion anchors the possible expansion from each local mover to a wider class.
Circular recurrence supplies a local figure for departure and return.
The same totalizer first places every member under a gathering statement.
Joining what was dispersed supplies convergence behind the earlier universal statement.
Presence and nearness supply the endpoint of that gathering.
The closing totalizer extends the frame to every thing.
Return to a prior point supplies the terminal direction for the widened circulation model.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from all gathered at 36:32 to each swimming at 36:40 and every thing returning at 36:83.
The repeated totalizer occupies comparable universal constructions at all three points.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated totalization, gathering, presence, circularity, and final return; I infer that celestial circulation exemplifies a surah-wide return order. A live alternative is that كُلّ in 36:40 remains grammatically local to the named cosmic members.

changed_reading.before: Each refers only to the nearby sun, moon, night, and day.
changed_reading.after: Those movers remain the immediate referents but also model the wider pattern in which every dispersed thing follows a governed trajectory toward return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 36:64 contextually concerns entering fire and the race-follower image is a distant lexical branch. It remains anchored because that branch explicitly names the competitor who follows the winner and the focus uses سَابِقُ; downstream prose should present it only as a branch-level race echo, not as a gloss of 36:64.

activation_trace.role: The winner's advance anchors a competitive ordering between night and day.
The muṣallī who follows the race-winner supplies a fixed second position that cannot invert with the leader.
The split inventory independently preserves following the winner in a race, reinforcing the positional echo.

changed_reading.before: Night merely fails to get ahead of day.
changed_reading.after: Night can be pictured as occupying a fixed follower-position in a race whose order has no overtaking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the source word in 36:48 means promise while the cited non-dominant mapped inventory carries swimming and the yearly circuit. It remains anchored through يَسْبَحُونَ and circular فَلَك; downstream prose should label it a form-distant temporal activation, not derive the lexical meaning of promise from ع و م.

activation_trace.role: Circular motion provides the spatial circuit that can receive a temporal cycle.
Swimming supplies the focus's mode of traversal.
Swimming or fluid travel in the split mapped root echoes the focus's mode at the question of appointed time.
The year as a completed circuit supplies a temporal orbit for approaching the promised appointment.

changed_reading.before: The orbit is a spatial circuit only.
changed_reading.after: The swimmers can also suggest traversal of an appointed yearly or epochal circuit toward a due time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 36:76 speaks of what people conceal and disclose, yet the cited branch explicitly names the crescent's concealment at month's end. It remains anchored in the focus's moon and circular course; downstream prose should qualify it as a lexical side-light on lunar phases, not transfer the human secrecy context directly to the moon.

activation_trace.role: The moon and its light anchor the phase-bearing object.
The lunar course supplies recurrence within which concealment and reappearance occur.
The crescent hidden at the end of the month supplies a phase-based explanation for apparent lunar disappearance.
Manifest appearance supplies the complementary re-emergence side of the concealment cycle.

changed_reading.before: A missing moon might look as though the sun had caught or erased it.
changed_reading.after: Lunar absence can be carried as scheduled concealment within its course, followed by manifestation rather than solar capture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines homonymous gambling, race-stake, and liability branches inside otherwise ordinary celestial nouns and verbs. It remains anchored in three focus roots and yields one coherent competition model; downstream prose should mark it as deliberate lexical play, not claim that قمر contextually means gambling.

activation_trace.role: Gambling, deceptive gain, and defeating another supply a contest over possession or victory.
The stake awarded to the race-winner supplies what competitive precedence would claim.
A pursuing liability or guarantee supplies the consequence that would attach if one competitor captured the other.

changed_reading.before: The clauses deny only physical interception and temporal precedence.
changed_reading.after: They can also negate a winner-takes-stake contest: no cosmic member defeats, acquires, or imposes liability on another.

strongest_changes: The measured sun and staged returning moon make non-overtaking a calibrated itinerary rather than accidental spacing.
The exact later ينبغي له construction shifts the sun's non-catching from raw inability toward role and category fit.
The next ayah's ship use of فلك activates a local vessel-and-swimmer echo inside the celestial course.
The سبحان refrain around يسبحون turns physical circulation into a live secondary image of praise.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reuse repeatedly changes the same focus lexemes: فلك becomes a laden ship, سبق becomes racing on a path, ينبغي له excludes an unfitting category, and سبح brackets the swimmers as explicit glorification. The packet's distant split branches additionally preserve contained race-position, yearly-swim, and concealed-crescent readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: كُلٌّ may remain local to the named cosmic members even though repeated totalizers support a wider gathering-and-return frame.
The vessel and praise activations may be rhetorical overtones rather than simultaneous lexical senses in the focus.
The ص ل ي race-follower and و ع د to ع و م mappings are too form-distant for unqualified downstream prose.
